chill.title: Terrasse des Epices Rooftop Afternoon
chill.description: Lounge in shaded wooden alcoves on an 800 m2 terrace floating above the souks.
chill.bonus: Grab a wooden alcove and stay through sunset.

chill.title: Menara Gardens Sunset
chill.description: Walk the olive groves to the 12th-century basin and pavilion with the Atlas behind.
chill.bonus: Photograph the pavilion reflected in the pool with the Atlas behind.

chill.title: Anima Garden Ourika
chill.description: Get lost in Andre Heller's surreal sculpture garden with palms, roses and Atlas views in the Ourika foothills.
chill.bonus: Find the giant head sculpture and pose with it.

chill.title: Les Bains de Marrakech Hammam
chill.description: Steam, scrub and massage in a Kasbah riad at the city's first luxury private spa, opened 2001.
chill.bonus: Book the black soap gommage and stay silent through it.

chill.title: La Mamounia Garden Tea
chill.description: Tea and Pierre Herme pastries in the 20 acres of orange groves at Marrakech's grand 1923 palace hotel.
chill.bonus: Order a Pierre Herme pastry you cannot pronounce.

chill.title: Hammam Mouassine Local Scrub
chill.description: Sweat and scrub alongside locals in one of the medina's oldest public bathhouses, dating to the 1500s.
chill.bonus: Bring your own black soap and kessa glove like a local.

chill.title: Cyber Park Picnic
chill.description: Shade under olive and orange trees in a royal 18th-century garden turned free public park by the Koutoubia.
chill.bonus: Bring msemmen and mint tea and stay until the call to prayer.

chill.title: Agdal Gardens Orchard Walk
chill.description: Stroll 12th-century royal orchards of olives, figs and pomegranates around a vast reflecting basin.
chill.bonus: Walk the full rim of the great water basin.

chill.title: Jardin Majorelle Morning Stroll
chill.description: Wander cactus and bamboo paths around the cobalt-blue villa restored by Yves Saint Laurent.
chill.bonus: Find the exact shade of Majorelle blue and match something you wear.

chill.title: Le Jardin Secret Courtyard Hour
chill.description: Sit in a restored 16th-century Islamic garden of fountains and orange trees in the middle of the souks.
chill.bonus: Climb the tower for a medina view.

social.title: Grand Cafe de la Poste Aperitif
social.description: Colonial-era brasserie from the 1920s in Gueliz, where the veranda fills for apero and oysters.
social.bonus: Order a kir and people-watch for twenty minutes.

social.title: Comptoir Darna Dinner and Show
social.description: Dine in Hivernage's legendary supper club as belly dancers, a Gnawa band and a DJ turn dinner into a party.
social.bonus: Get up and dance before the candle-tray dancers finish.

social.title: Marrakech International Film Festival
social.description: Red carpets, premieres and free public screenings in the square during the city's annual film festival.
social.bonus: Catch the free open-air screening in Jemaa el-Fnaa.

social.title: Le 68 Bar a Vin
social.description: A rustic two-floor Gueliz wine bar with a curated list, charcuterie and a busy patio.
social.bonus: Ask for a Moroccan wine and guess the region.

social.title: Gnaoua World Music Festival
social.description: Three days of free Gnawa trance and world music on stages across Essaouira's seaside medina.
social.bonus: Join a lila circle and stay until sunrise.

social.title: Sky Bar at La Renaissance Hotel
social.description: A 360-degree seventh-floor rooftop bar in Gueliz for sunset drinks over the whole city.
social.bonus: Spot the Koutoubia and the Atlas from the same seat.

social.title: Le Salama Sky Bar
social.description: A three-floor medina venue with a sky bar at Koutoubia eye level and belly dancing below.

social.title: Cafe Clock Storytelling Night
social.description: Hear young storytellers revive the hikayat tradition in Darija and English over camel burgers in the Kasbah.
social.bonus: Learn the closing line of a hikaya and repeat it to a friend.

social.title: Theatro Club Night
social.description: Dance in a 1950s music hall turned club inside the Es Saadi resort, with fire acts and themed nights all week.

social.title: Chez Ali Fantasia Night
social.description: A huge tented dinner with horseback charges, musket fire and folklore troupes on the Palmeraie edge.
social.bonus: Cheer loud enough that a rider salutes you.

social.title: Kabana Koutoubia Rooftop
social.description: Cocktails, tapas and weekend DJs on a rooftop staring straight at the Koutoubia minaret.
social.bonus: Toast the Koutoubia at the exact moment it lights up.

culture.title: Maison de la Photographie
culture.description: A riad of vintage Moroccan photographs from 1870-1950 with a rooftop cafe.
culture.bonus: Find a photo of a place you have already visited.

culture.title: Musee Yves Saint Laurent
culture.description: Couture, sketches and photos from the designer who called Marrakech home, in a striking brick building.
culture.bonus: Sketch a dress from the collection in your notes.

culture.title: Bahia Palace Courtyards
culture.description: Painted cedar ceilings and zellij courtyards in a 19th-century vizier's palace.
culture.bonus: Find the ceiling with the most colors and count them.

culture.title: Ait Benhaddou Ksar
culture.description: Climb the mud-brick fortified village on the old caravan route, a UNESCO site and film set for Gladiator.
culture.bonus: Climb to the granary at the top before noon.

culture.title: El Badi Palace Ramparts
culture.description: Walk the sunken gardens and ruined walls of a 16th-century palace built with Italian marble.
culture.bonus: Climb the ramparts and find a stork nest.

culture.title: Ben Youssef Madrasa
culture.description: The largest Quranic school in Morocco, with a stunning stucco and cedar courtyard.
culture.bonus: Peek into a student cell and imagine living there.

culture.title: Saadian Tombs
culture.description: The lavish 16th-century royal necropolis hidden behind the Kasbah Mosque.
culture.bonus: Spot the Hall of Twelve Columns.

culture.title: Koutoubia Mosque Gardens
culture.description: Walk the rose gardens under the 12th-century minaret that defines the city skyline.
culture.bonus: Listen to the call to prayer from the gardens.

8ball.title: Get Lost in Souk Semmarine
8ball.description: Dive into the medina's main souk with no plan and follow whatever lane looks most interesting.
8ball.bonus: Put your phone away and navigate back to Jemaa el-Fnaa without maps.

8ball.title: Scarabeo Camp Desert Night
8ball.description: Spontaneously swap your riad for a luxury tented camp in the Agafay desert with candlelit dinner and live music.
8ball.bonus: Sleep with the tent flap open to the stars.

adventure.title: Pikala Bikes Medina Cycling Tour
adventure.description: Pedal the Kasbah, Agdal and back lanes with young local guides from a bike social enterprise, ending with tea at the Pikala cafe.
adventure.bonus: Ring your bell at the Zaouia of Sidi Bel Abbes finish line.

adventure.title: Ciel d'Afrique Sunrise Balloon Flight
adventure.description: Float over the Jbilet hills and Berber villages at dawn with Morocco's oldest balloon operator, then land to a Moroccan breakfast.
adventure.bonus: Learn to say 'shukran' to the pilot in Darija before touchdown.

adventure.title: Ouzoud Falls Hike and Boat Ride
adventure.description: Hike down to Morocco's tallest waterfall, 110 m of cascades, and take a raft right up to the spray.
adventure.bonus: Spot a Barbary macaque and get a photo without feeding it.

adventure.title: Setti Fatma Seven Waterfalls Scramble
adventure.description: Scramble up boulders past riverside cafes to the cascades above Setti Fatma in the Ourika Valley.
adventure.bonus: Make it to the fourth waterfall without a local guide pointing the way.

adventure.title: Oukaimeden Ski Day
adventure.description: Ski Africa's highest ski area, with a chairlift to 3,258 m and donkey rides to the slopes, 75 km from Marrakech.
adventure.bonus: Ride the chairlift to the 3,258 m top station and snap the Atlas panorama.

adventure.title: La Pause Agafay Camel Ride
adventure.description: Ride camels across the stony Agafay desert to an off-grid oasis lodge with no electricity and candlelit dinners.
adventure.bonus: Ride without your phone for the whole sunset.

adventure.title: Terres d'Amanar Atlas Zipline
adventure.description: Fly over Atlas foothill ravines on ziplines and suspended bridges at a mountain adventure park in Tahanaout.
adventure.bonus: Ride one zipline backwards, if the guide says it is safe.

adventure.title: Mount Toubkal Summit Trek
adventure.description: Summit North Africa's highest peak at 4,167 m on a two-day trek from Imlil with a night at the Toubkal refuge.
adventure.bonus: Pack one Moroccan flag sticker and leave a photo of it at 4,167 m on your phone lock screen.

adventure.title: Sidi Kaouki Beach Surf Session
adventure.description: Rent a board and surf the wild Atlantic swells at the windswept beach village south of Essaouira.
adventure.bonus: Catch one wave and ride it all the way to the sand.

adventure.title: Lalla Takerkoust Lake Day
adventure.description: Swim and picnic at the turquoise reservoir framed by the Atlas, 40 minutes from the city.
adventure.bonus: Swim out until the Atlas peaks line up behind you and take the shot.

adventure.title: Tizi n'Tichka Pass Road Trip
adventure.description: Drive the hairpin road over the High Atlas to the 2,260 m Tichka pass for some of Morocco's wildest views.
adventure.bonus: Pull over at the 2,260 m summit sign and buy a fossil from a roadside stall.

adventure.title: Oasiria Water Park Day
adventure.description: Cool off on slides, a wave pool and a lazy river in a palm-shaded water park, Morocco's most popular.
adventure.bonus: Ride the tallest slide first, before you can talk yourself out of it.

adventure.title: Tizi n'Mzik Pass Hike
adventure.description: Climb a steep mule path from Imlil to a 2,489 m pass with views down two valleys.
adventure.bonus: Eat lunch at the 2,489 m pass with your boots off.

adventure.title: Palmeraie Camel Trek
adventure.description: Plod through Marrakech's 13,000-hectare palm grove on camelback as the light turns gold.
adventure.bonus: Name your camel and tell the handler.

adventure.title: Imlil to Aroumd Valley Hike
adventure.description: Walk walnut groves and terraced fields from Imlil up to the Berber village of Aroumd beneath Toubkal.
adventure.bonus: Accept a mint tea from a village terrace and ask the host's name.

adventure.title: ION Club Essaouira Kitesurf Lesson
adventure.description: Learn to kitesurf in Essaouira's famously windy bay with VDWS and IKO certified instructors.
adventure.bonus: Stand up on the board for a count of five and celebrate at the Ocean Vagabond terrace next door.

foodie.title: Al Fassia Women-Run Feast
foodie.description: A Gueliz legend run entirely by women, famous for slow-cooked lamb shoulder and pigeon pastilla.
foodie.bonus: Pre-order the dalaa mbakhra a day ahead.

foodie.title: Nomad Rooftop Dinner
foodie.description: Modern Moroccan food on a four-floor rooftop above the spice square, with Atlas views at sunset.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish with the most spices you cannot name.

foodie.title: Chez Lamine Mechoui Lunch
foodie.description: Pit-roasted lamb sold by weight with cumin salt and bread, a medina institution since 1965.
foodie.bonus: Eat with your hands only, no cutlery.

foodie.title: Le Jardin Garden Lunch
foodie.description: Lunch under banana trees in a green-tiled riad courtyard hidden in the souks.
foodie.bonus: Find the resident tortoise in the courtyard.

foodie.title: Amal Women's Center Cooking Class
foodie.description: Cook tagines with women training for culinary careers at a nonprofit kitchen in Targa.
foodie.bonus: Learn to fold a msemmen and make one on your own.

foodie.title: Essaouira Port Fish Grill
foodie.description: Choose sardines and sea bream from the harbour stalls and have them grilled on the spot.
foodie.bonus: Pick your fish straight off a boat and bargain for it.

foodie.title: Dar Yacout Feast Night
foodie.description: A lantern-lit 19th-century riad serving a set multi-course Moroccan feast with live music.
foodie.bonus: Get to the rooftop for the Koutoubia view before the first course.

foodie.title: Jemaa el-Fnaa Night Food Stalls
foodie.description: Squeeze onto benches at the smoking grill stalls of the world's most famous square for harira, brochettes and sheep's head.
foodie.bonus: Try the snail soup at a stall and finish the bowl.

foodie.title: Mellah Spice Market Browse
foodie.description: Browse the covered spice and dried-rose market in the old Jewish quarter, calmer and cheaper than the main souks.
foodie.bonus: Learn one Hebrew or Darija word from a stall keeper.

foodie.title: Bacha Coffee at Dar el Bacha
foodie.description: Choose from 200 single-origin coffees in the gilded palace salon where the brand began in 1910.
foodie.bonus: Order a coffee from a country you have never been to.

foodie.title: Rahba Kedima Spice Square Tasting
foodie.description: Sniff and taste ras el hanout, saffron and amber at the stalls of the old spice square.
foodie.bonus: Buy one spice you have never cooked with and use it this week.

foodie.title: La Maison Arabe Cooking Workshop
foodie.description: Cook tagine, salads and bread with a traditional dada, then eat it under fig and olive trees.
foodie.bonus: Ask your dada for the one spice secret not in the recipe.
